properties.name: display
properties.description: flex, grid, block or none. Example: display: flex

properties.name: flex-direction
properties.description: row or column. Example: display: flex; flex-direction: column

properties.name: flex-wrap
properties.description: nowrap or wrap (flow container). Example: display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap

properties.name: gap
properties.description: flex containers and grids. Example: display: flex; gap: 8px

properties.name: justify-content
properties.description: start, center, end. Example: display: flex; justify-content: center

properties.name: align-items
properties.description: start, center, end, stretch. Example: display: flex; align-items: center

properties.name: align-self
properties.description: start, center, end, stretch. Example: align-self: center

properties.name: flex-grow
properties.description: needs a flex parent. Example: flex-grow: 1

properties.name: flex
properties.description: 1, auto, 0, none. Example: flex: 1

properties.name: vertical-align
properties.description: top, middle, bottom. Example: vertical-align: middle

properties.name: text-align
properties.description: left, center, right. Example: text-align: center

properties.name: width
properties.description: fixed size (minimum and maximum). Example: width: 120px

properties.name: height
properties.description: fixed size (minimum and maximum). Example: height: 40px

properties.name: min-width
properties.description: px or rem. Example: min-width: 120px

properties.name: min-height
properties.description: px or rem. Example: min-height: 40px

properties.name: max-width
properties.description: px or rem. Example: max-width: 300px

properties.name: max-height
properties.description: px or rem. Example: max-height: 300px

properties.name: margin
properties.description: one to four lengths; margin-top/right/bottom/left too. Example: margin: 4px 8px

properties.name: padding
properties.description: on a flex or grid element it wraps the container in a Border. Example: padding: 4px 8px

properties.name: border-width
properties.description: one to four lengths. Example: border-width: 1px

properties.name: border-color
properties.description: #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA. Example: border-color: #33CDFF

properties.name: border-radius
properties.description: one to four radii. Example: border-radius: 3px

properties.name: background-color
properties.description: #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA. Example: background-color: #112233

properties.name: background
properties.description: linear-gradient and radial-gradient. Example: background: linear-gradient(180deg, #000000, #FFFFFF)

properties.name: color
properties.description: text color. Example: color: #E0F8FF

properties.name: font-size
properties.description: px or rem. Example: font-size: 24px

properties.name: font-weight
properties.description: normal, bold, 400, 700. Example: font-weight: bold

properties.name: font-style
properties.description: normal, italic, oblique. Example: font-style: italic

properties.name: opacity
properties.description: 0 to 1. Example: opacity: 0.5

properties.name: overflow
properties.description: hidden clips; wrap in f-scroll to scroll. Example: overflow: hidden

properties.name: box-shadow
properties.description: x y [blur [spread]] color [inset]. Example: box-shadow: 0 2px 4px #80000000

properties.name: text-shadow
properties.description: x y color (blur is not drawn). Example: text-shadow: 1px 1px #000000

properties.name: text-transform
properties.description: uppercase or none. Example: text-transform: uppercase

properties.name: text-overflow
properties.description: ellipsis or clip. Example: text-overflow: ellipsis

properties.name: white-space
properties.description: nowrap or normal. Example: white-space: nowrap

properties.name: transform
properties.description: translate(), scale(), rotate(). Example: transform: scale(1.1)

properties.name: transform-origin
properties.description: keywords and percentages. Example: transform-origin: 50% 50%

properties.name: pointer-events
properties.description: none (ignores the mouse) or auto (stops it, as a modal backdrop does). Example: pointer-events: none

properties.name: z-index
properties.description: an integer; the higher value draws and hit-tests on top. Example: z-index: 10

properties.name: transition
properties.description: property and duration. Example: transition: opacity 150ms

properties.name: box-sizing
properties.description: border-box only. Example: box-sizing: border-box

properties.name: grid-template-columns
properties.description: px and fr tracks. Example: display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr

properties.name: -f-*
properties.description: Sets any Forma property verbatim: -f-FontFamily: resource(Key).
A custom property in :root is a theme token and the resource key itself.

pseudoElements.name: ::part()
pseudoElements.description: Selects a template part marked with the part attribute.
